title: Exprosion
description: 与AI协作的项目，旨在创建真实的爆炸,A project in collaboration with AI aimed at creating real explosions
body:
这是与AI协作的项目，为游戏添加了一个法杖，位于创造模式武器栏。蓄力30秒触发大范围爆炸
不同于原版的是，这个爆炸有自己的数学模型，爆炸分为6层，具体可以查看源码

机翻 · 通用领域（Machine translation · General field）
This is a collaborative project with AI that adds a wand to the game, located in the weapon bar of the creation mode. Charging for 30 seconds triggers a large-scale explosion
Unlike the original version, this explosion has its own mathematical model and is divided into 6 layers. Please refer to the source code for details
